assets.name: chex
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original premium illustrated game-library cover for the family friendly sci-fi game Chex Quest. Landscape 16:9. A brave cereal-shaped astronaut in golden square woven waffle armor and a glossy domed helmet, dark teal undersuit, holding a chunky nonlethal futuristic zapping device, faces a few playful lime-green slime aliens in a bright space-station corridor. Confident adventure pose, lively clean colors, glowing turquoise and warm gold lighting, polished hand-painted 3D animated adventure look with clear readable silhouette. Main figure centered and safe in a central square crop; composition must read at small128x72 tile and640x360 cover size. Newly drawn cover art, not a reproduction of existing box art or a screenshot. No text or letters, no branding or logos, no UI, no watermark, no borders, no scary gore.
assets.provenance: New original generated launcher illustration; no WAD or game data extracted.

conversion: Lanczos fit, median-cut256 indexed RGB565, no runtime image decoding
